name: INVICTUS
fullName: Rivaroxaban in Rheumatic Heart Disease-Associated Atrial Fibrillation
population: n=4531, mean 50.5; 72.3% women, NIHSS AF with echocardiographic rheumatic heart disease, restricted mean survival analysis over ~4.6 years
finding: VKA SUPERIOR: restricted mean survival 1599 d (rivaroxaban) vs 1675 d (VKA)
teachingPoint: Use warfarin, not a DOAC, for AF with rheumatic mitral valve disease — rivaroxaban had worse cardiovascular outcomes and higher mortality.
